tools.description: Search the open healthcare jobs at 2,098 US hospitals, health systems, clinic groups and care companies (nurses, CNAs, doctors, NPs and PAs, therapists, techs, pharmacy, caregivers, front office and more), plus the listings of the job boards the site reads, each naming its employer. tools.name: get_healthcare_pay
tools.description: What healthcare jobs post as pay today, measured from the hourly rates open jobs state (before shift differentials and bonuses): with no arguments, the median and typical range for every kind of job (a market rate only where at least three employers post one); with a kind of job, that job's pay and

tools.name: get_healthcare_job_market
tools.description: How many healthcare jobs are open right now, how many were first listed in the last 7 days and how many are listed per week, with the open jobs by kind of job, by US state and by employer (with each employer's slug for the other tools).

tools.name: get_healthcare_jobs_by_state
tools.description: With no state, every US state's open healthcare jobs and employers. With a state, its open jobs by kind of job, the hourly pay its jobs post, the towns and employers with the most jobs and its newest jobs. With a state and a kind of job, the same for that job in that state (e.g. CNA jobs in Ohio).

tools.name: list_healthcare_employers
tools.description: The hospitals, health systems, clinic groups and care companies whose jobs CareJobs.Now reads, most open jobs first, with where each hires, its open jobs and its posted pay. tools.name: get_healthcare_employer
tools.description: One employer (or AI-training program or job board): what it is, where it hires, its open jobs right now by kind of job, the pay its jobs post, its newest and best-paid open jobs, and links to its page and every open job.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_healthcare_pay, get_healthcare_jobs_by_state, get_healthcare_employer · Public sink: get_healthcare_pay, get_healthcare_jobs_by_state, get_healthcare_employer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_healthcare_pay, get_healthcare_jobs_by_state, get_healthcare_employer · Public sink: get_healthcare_pay, get_healthcare_jobs_by_state, get_healthcare_employer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
